definitions.explanation: The act of closing off or blocking access to an area, border, account, or system to prevent entry, exit, or use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The police have sealed off the area around the scene.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The city was locked down to prevent the spread of the infection.

notes:
FORMS:
{封|ふう} (seal) + {鎖|さ} (chain, lock). Used as both a noun and suru-verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}: road blockade
- ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}: border closure
- {都市|とし}{封鎖|ふうさ}: city lockdown
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}: account freeze
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}: economic blockade

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{封鎖|ふうさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to seal off/block ~
- {封鎖|ふうさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: the blockade is lifted

USAGE:
Gained wider everyday usage during pandemic discussions as the Japanese equivalent of "lockdown," though the loanword ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧⟦ダウン→ダウン：00035_daun⟧ is also used. Traditionally associated with military blockades, police cordons, and border closures.
